verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's integrated authenticator generates TOTP codes inside the vault, and its TOTP sync docs say that once Authenticator is connected to Password Manager, the Bitwarden apps stay synchronized with any codes you add or edit. The docs also describe the mobile apps and browser extension as access points for vault items, so codes follow the vault across clients. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming simultaneous phone, tablet and computer availability; independent hands-on corroboration that token sync works reliably.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically

citations.quote: Once activated, the Bitwarden apps stay synchronized with any codes you add or edit
it automatically produces the time-based one-time passwords (TOTPs), six-digit codes using SHA-1 that rotate every 30 seconds
use the browser extension or mobile apps to autofill them across the apps and websites you use every day
